masteryTreeExplorer.h1: Your League of Legends Mastery Tree
masteryTreeExplorer.heroText: Every champion you have mastered becomes a branch in your personal Runeterra. Explore every champion, add your mastery points, and share the tree that tells your League story.
masteryTreeExplorer.modeExploreHint: Every champion, grouped by primary role.
masteryTreeExplorer.searchNoResults: No champion found in this view.
masteryTreeExplorer.searchHint: Press Enter to open the first result.
masteryTreeExplorer.sizeByMasteryHint: Node size follows mastery points. Turn off for equal-size nodes.
masteryTreeExplorer.treeHint: Drag to pan · Scroll or pinch to zoom · Select a champion for details
masteryTreeExplorer.treeHintMobile: Drag to pan · Pinch to zoom · Tap a champion
masteryTreeExplorer.zoomToNames: Zoom in to reveal champion names.
masteryTreeExplorer.loadingBody: Loading champion artwork and role data.
masteryTreeExplorer.loadErrorBody: Champion data could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
masteryTreeExplorer.emptyPersonalBody: Add the champions you play and their mastery points. Your highest-mastery champion becomes the root.
masteryTreeExplorer.tooltipExploreHint: Select for details. Personalize to add your mastery.
masteryTreeExplorer.legendSizeBody: Larger nodes hold more mastery points. The scale is square-root based, so one huge champion never hides the rest. Explore mode uses equal-size nodes.
masteryTreeExplorer.legendColorBody: Each branch grows from a primary role: top, jungle, mid, ADC, or support. Multi-role champions appear under their primary role and show all roles in their details.
masteryTreeExplorer.legendBranchBody: The golden trunk leads to the root champion. Role branches connect related champions. Hide branches any time without changing the layout.
masteryTreeExplorer.legendLevelBody: When a mastery level is known, a badge marks it. Level colors are a visual aid; the number and points are always written in the details.
masteryTreeExplorer.legendRootBody: Your highest-mastery champion sits at the center of a personalized tree. The default explorer uses a neutral root because no personal mastery data is implied.
masteryTreeExplorer.instructionsMouse: Mouse: drag to pan, scroll to zoom, click a champion for details.
masteryTreeExplorer.instructionsTouch: Touch: drag to pan, pinch to zoom, tap a champion for details.
masteryTreeExplorer.instructionsKeyboard: Keyboard: use the search field to find a champion, then press Enter. Tab moves through controls and results.
masteryTreeExplorer.directoryBody: Browse every champion in the current view without using the canvas.
masteryTreeExplorer.detailsNoMastery: No personal mastery has been added for this champion.
masteryTreeExplorer.detailsNoGuide: No dedicated guide yet. Browse all guides instead.
masteryTreeExplorer.personalizeIntro: Add champions manually or import a mastery file. Everything stays in your browser unless you choose to share it.
masteryTreeExplorer.personalizeSelectedEmptyBody: Pick champions from the list on the right. Your tree updates as you go.
masteryTreeExplorer.personalizePointsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 999,999,999.
masteryTreeExplorer.personalizePrivacy: Your data never leaves this browser unless you copy a share link or export an image.
masteryTreeExplorer.importIntro: Upload a JSON file with champion mastery entries. This is the same shape used by Riot's champion mastery API, or a LeagueRoulette export.
masteryTreeExplorer.importDrop: Drop a JSON file here or choose a file
masteryTreeExplorer.importFileHint: JSON only · Maximum 2 MB · Data is validated locally
masteryTreeExplorer.importRiotBody: If you already signed in to LeagueRoulette with Riot, you can fetch your mastery from our server. Nothing is stored by this page.
masteryTreeExplorer.importRiotError: We couldn't load mastery from your account. Your session may have expired.
masteryTreeExplorer.importRiotSuccess: Imported {count} champions from your Riot account.
masteryTreeExplorer.importSuccessWithSkipped: Imported {count} champions. Skipped {skipped} entries with unknown champion IDs.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorInvalidJson: That file is not valid JSON.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorShape: The file does not contain a supported mastery list.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorNoEntries: No usable mastery entries were found.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorTooLarge: The file is too large. The limit is 2 MB.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorTooMany: The file contains too many entries.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorNoMatch: None of the champion IDs in the file match the current roster.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorRead: The file could not be read. Try another file.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorPoints: One or more mastery point values are invalid.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorLevel: One or more mastery levels are invalid.
masteryTreeExplorer.importErrorGeneric: The import failed. Check the file and try again.
masteryTreeExplorer.importSupportedFormat: Supported fields: championId, championPoints (or points), championLevel (or level). The champion id must be Riot's numeric champion id.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareIntro: Choose how you want to share your League journey.
masteryTreeExplorer.sharePrivateNote: Your mastery values are encoded in the link and image you choose to share. Anyone with them can see those values. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.
masteryTreeExplorer.sharePublicNote: You are sharing the full champion explorer. Add your own mastery to share a personal tree.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareLinkError: The link could not be copied. Select the URL below and copy it manually.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareNativeError: Sharing is not available in this browser.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareImageError: The image could not be exported. Try another browser or take a screenshot.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareExportNote: The image is a composed 1200×630 share card, not a screenshot of the page.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareTopNote: Share links include your top {count} champions by mastery to keep the URL short.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareImageTitle: My League of Legends Mastery Tree
masteryTreeExplorer.shareImageDisclaimer: Fan-made. Not affiliated with Riot Games.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareLoadedBody: You are viewing a tree shared through a link. It only contains the values its author chose to share.
masteryTreeExplorer.seoTitle: League of Legends Mastery Tree | LeagueRoulette
masteryTreeExplorer.seoDescription: Explore every League of Legends champion in an interactive mastery tree. Visualize your favorite champions, customize your tree, and share your results.
masteryTreeExplorer.howTitle: A mastery tree built around your journey
masteryTreeExplorer.howBody: Your champion mastery is more than a number. The tree turns it into a landscape: your main champion becomes the root, your role picks form the strongest branches, and every champion you have played finds a place in the canopy.
masteryTreeExplorer.howPoint1Body: The same data always produces the same tree. Champions are grouped by primary role and ordered by mastery rank, so the shape stays familiar instead of reshuffling on every visit.
masteryTreeExplorer.howPoint2Body: Mastery points and levels appear only when you add or import them. Explore mode never invents ownership, points, or ranks.
masteryTreeExplorer.howPoint3Body: Explore the complete roster without signing in. If you already connected Riot to LeagueRoulette, you can import your mastery directly; otherwise, add champions manually or import a JSON file.
masteryTreeExplorer.shareSectionTitle: Show people the shape of your League journey
masteryTreeExplorer.shareSectionBody: Create a clean 1200×630 share card with your root champion, top champions, and mastery values. Send a link or post the image wherever your friends hang out.
masteryTreeExplorer.disclaimer: LeagueRoulette is an independent fan project. League of Legends and all champion assets belong to Riot Games, Inc. This tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.
masteryTreeExplorer.dataSource: Champion data and artwork: Riot Data Dragon {version}. Mastery values are user-provided or fetched from the Riot account you connected to LeagueRoulette.
masteryTreeExplorer.systemError: Something went wrong. The rest of the page is still available.
